original_reference_provenance.finding: Historical Julia implements the same idealized momentum/Newton-Schulz update using allFP32 working matrices, while native uses BF16 storage and rounding after each NS stage. This is a P1 precision/mapping fidelity compromise, not an established wrong idealized optimizer or observed historical failure. Named reference restores actual source BF16 pipeline, vector4 work assignment, fused transposes and explicit vendor GEMM ABI.
